why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Settings now shows the credit history under the credit balance, in English and Korean. Each row has the date and time in local time, what the credits were for, and the amount: charges show as red negatives, refunds and refills as green positives. Refunds carry a "Refund" / "환불" tag next to what they refunded. The type-check passes and lint adds no new problems, but I did not open the page in a browser, so the layout has not been seen. The history reloads when the balance changes. When you switch workspaces, the previous workspace's rows stay visible until the new ones load.

+import uuid

+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=h)

+def new_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_new_workspace_has_empty_history(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    r = history(client, h, workspace_id(client, h))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json() == []
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charges_refunds_and_refills_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = new_project(client, h)
+
+    client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h)  # grants the daily refill
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)  # succeeds: charged
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)  # fails: charged, then refunded
+
+    r = history(client, h, ws)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [
+        (15, "refund:generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (50, "daily_refill"),
+    ]
+    times = [datetime.fromisoformat(i["created_at"]) for i in items]
+    assert times == sorted(times, reverse=True)
+    # The history adds up to the balance: 500 welcome credits + changes.
+    balance = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    assert 500 + sum(i["amount"] for i in items) == balance
+
+

+    a = signup(client, "a@example.com")

+

+the generation it paid for fails, whether it runs in the request or in a

+
+
+def server_error(call):
+    """Runs a request whose AI call fails with an unhandled error. The test
+    client re-raises it (a real server answers 500)."""
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Gemini is unavailable"):
+        call()
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def refunds(action_type):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        return s.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.action_type == f"refund:{action_type}")).all()
+
+
+def new_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def new_character(client, h, project_id):

+    return r.json()["id"]
+

+
+    with Session(engine) as s:

+        s.add(ep)
+        s.flush()
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=ep.id, cut_order=1, script="A bus at night", selected_layout="Square", aspect_ratio="1:1")
+        s.add(cut)

+        return str(ep.id), str(cut.id)
